title: Title Case Words
description: Write a function `title_case_words(sentence)` that capitalizes the first letter of each word in a string, leaving other letters unchanged. Return an empty string if the input is empty.
hints: String transformation often involves decomposing into words, processing, and recombining.
Pay attention to how spaces are preserved between words.
Using split() without arguments collapses multiple consecutive spaces into a single space.
Split by ' ' and capitalize non-empty tokens: ' '.join(w.capitalize() if w else '' for w in sentence.split(' ')).
